sampling_algorithm: ascending SHA256 of UTF8(seed|stratum|business_id), tie by business_id
random_frame: all 2000 frozen train business IDs, independent of all targets/checkpoint outputs
targeted_exclusion: exclude random24 and all previously selected targeted businesses
insufficient_pool: stop and explicitly report; no threshold changes or fabricated replacements

eligibility.zero_filtered: exactly zero retained frozen Filtered captions
eligibility.review_disagreement: at least 5 selected reviews with stars>=4 AND at least 5 with stars<=2
eligibility.varied_visual: at least 4 retained U captions, at least 4 distinct source photos, and at least 3 lexical scene families across those captions
eligibility.information_dense: at least 24 selected reviews, at least 3500 frozen RO source tokens, and at least 6 review aspect families occurring in at least 2 selected reviews each

interpretation: source-only lexical eligibility proxies; varied scenes do not prove contradictory captions, star disagreement does not prove same-aspect disagreement; do not prioritize opinions or score summaries from these proxies
